reframe: The adversary is not the critic but the flood. Both prior framings (calibration object, adversarial object) put the examiner at the centre. Under conditions of no centrality, no attention, no trial, and an oversupply of writing in which merit does not sort, the survival problem is not BE GOOD but GIVE PEOPLE WHO DO NOT CARE ABOUT YOU REASONS TO COPY YOU.

why_better: requires only an understanding that writing survives by being copied — publishing, not prescience
does not require one author, only one intention about transmission — neutral on the authorship question
explains the SHAPE of survival: this corpus survived WITH its disputes, spuria and unnamed genre intact, where most corpora shed that machinery
testable: Survival is comparative and the losses are documented. Diogenes Laertius preserves book-lists — attributed versus extant, by author, one source, consistent coverage. What distinguishes what survived from what was lost, in the same tradition?
candidate_properties: title naming a person rather than a topic
position in a numbered arrangement — a numbered set makes its own gaps visible
feasibility_must_precede_registration: are the book-lists extractable as structured data
is coverage sufficient — how many authors, how many titles
can extant status be assigned without circular recourse to modern editions
is single-source bias tolerable or determinative
precedent: Sappho 31 survives inside Longinus. A text addressed past its own moment to a reader who does not yet exist survives because someone later needed it.
